summary: Paired command-only clients retain their own P-256 key, support explicit client Unix sockets, and sign purpose-bound device results without message authority.

compatibility.detail: Device profiles can retain P-256 keys for control.commands without a message delegation chain; existing message signing remains unchanged.

manual.detail: Source only; pairing and enrollment still require their approvals.

recovery.detail: Revoke the isolated pairing and revert the source change.
